source_text:
domain define-non-collapse "Define term non-collapse"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner cyberalchemy-define-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema NonCollapseFacts:
  terms_valid: boolean
  pair_targets_valid: boolean
  pair_coverage_complete: boolean
  evidence_valid: boolean
  terms_distinct: boolean
  pairs_resolved: boolean
  option_coverage_complete: boolean
  definitions_distinct: boolean

schema NonCollapseDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(pass|block)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(none|non-collapse)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping NonCollapseBlocked:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-BLOCKED"
  meaning "Block when term identities, pair coverage, evidence, option coverage, or candidate definitions collapse."
  target NonCollapseDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "non-collapse"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping NonCollapsePass:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-PASS"
  meaning "Pass when every candidate term pair is covered, evidenced, resolved, and operationally distinct."
  target NonCollapseDecision
  field status = "pass"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule NonCollapseHasDefect:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-DEFECT"
  meaning "At least one required non-collapse fact is false."
  condition not (input.terms_valid and input.pair_targets_valid and input.pair_coverage_complete and input.evidence_valid and input.terms_distinct and input.pairs_resolved and input.option_coverage_complete and input.definitions_distinct)

rule NonCollapseIsReady:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-READY"
  meaning "Every required non-collapse fact is true."
  condition input.terms_valid and input.pair_targets_valid and input.pair_coverage_complete and input.evidence_valid and input.terms_distinct and input.pairs_resolved and input.option_coverage_complete and input.definitions_distinct

result EvaluateNonCollapse:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-EVALUATE-NON-COLLAPSE"
  meaning "Choose the term non-collapse disposition from normalized evidence facts."
  when NonCollapseHasDefect yield NonCollapseBlocked
  when NonCollapseIsReady yield NonCollapsePass

endpoint DefineNonCollapse:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/non-collapse"
  input NonCollapseFacts
  output NonCollapseDecision
  result EvaluateNonCollapse
  auth-env DEFINE_LANGUAGE_GATE_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status pass 200
  status block 422
